text:
mike_support: Support -> CS: urgent handoff for Aurelia Labs. Onboarding blocked — embeddings similarity falling (~15% drop) and ingest returns intermittent 412/timeout. Activation dipped to 28%. Renewal check-in scheduled next week so we need CS takeover and a customer bridge ASAP. I've attached minimal logs and a repro.

julian_support_engineer: Repro'd on their tenant; ingest worker timeouts spiked after last quantization push. Temporarily removed the aggressive batching; applied a rate-limit bypass for Aurelia to keep them online. Rolling back quant patch next if needed. Link to internal incident: https://redwood.internal/incident/5821

elaine_csm: Thanks — I'll take customer lead. Please add me to the customer thread and drop a short RCA summary I can share. I can host a 30m bridge at 3pm PT today. @sana_csm_manager FYI — if activation metrics don't recover, escalate to renewal ops.

sana_csm_manager: Acknowledged. If activation <30% post-bridge we prepare renewal mitigation (credits + exec outreach). Draft comms plan: 1) immediate: apology + mitigation note, 2) bridge: RCA + timeline, 3) follow-up: postmortem + remediation timeline.

mike_support: Added Elaine to the customer thread and pasted logs. Quick customer-facing blurb you can use: "We're investigating an ingestion error affecting embeddings; we've applied a temporary bypass and expect improvement in ~30m. We'll share a root cause and remediation plan after the bridge."

elaine_csm: Good. Can someone pull token-level cost/latency deltas for their org so I can quantify impact in the renewal play?

julian_support_engineer: Pulling now — quick snapshot: avg generation latency per token 320ms -> 520ms after patch; ingest error rate 0.1% -> 4.5%. Paste to thread in 2m.

oncall_ops_bot: Incident 5821 created and linked. Priority: P2 escalated to CS. Bridge scheduled: 2026-03-23T15:00:00-07:00. Eng oncall has been paged.

sana_csm_manager: Comms plan draft and owners: (a) Immediate notice = Elaine, (b) Bridge + RCA = Julian (tech) + Mike (support), (c) Postmortem + credits = Sana. If metrics don't improve, route to renewal ops and loop in sales exec.

elaine_csm: I'll send the invite and the short message now. Who will demo the mitigation (rollback/q2)? @julian_support_engineer?

julian_support_engineer: I'll demo. Runbook rollback snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal/api/v1/admin/rollback -d '{"tenant":"aurelia","version":"q2"}'
```

mike_support: Confirmed — invite sent to customer, Elaine, Sana, Julian. I'll join the bridge and surface live logs. Sync 10m before.

elaine_csm: Perfect. After the call I'll update the renewal playbook and flag for sales if metrics don't recover. :thumbsup:
